verdict.rationale: Anytype is clearly local-first and offline-capable: content is stored locally in an encrypted Vault on your device, the app always works without internet, and a local-only mode removes the backup node entirely. However, the store is an encrypted, app-specific format (the team says data is encrypted at rest), so reading notes without the app requires exporting to Markdown or Any-Block rather than opening plain local files. Missing for 10: notes stored as plain files directly readable without the app, independent hands-on corroboration of offline behavior.
